newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 19.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:

-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto indicates that government should speed up its fiscal reform target of cutting the budget deficit to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) by fiscal 2003, two years earlier than the initial deadline of fiscal 2005.
-- North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop arrives in the Philippines from China.
-- Administrative reform panel calls for anti-terrorism force team under prime minister.
-- Asahi Chemical Industry to cut domestic synthetic resin production.
-- Finance Ministry plans to ease curbs on banks' brokerage and trust affiliates.
